title: SYNTHETIC EVAL PLAN - synthetic-nasty (blind transcription, trial t2)
interpretations: Walk order per house protocol: each room starts at its top-left corner heading E, then clockwise; run 0 is the top wall.

The 'heater from 17'6" length 10" depth 10"' label sits at the ell/adjacent gap; assigned to ell run 0 (top wall) because 17'6" + 10" = 18'4" lands exactly on the ell's NE corner, matching the dashed box drawn at that corner.
The bulkhead dashed box is drawn vertically along the ell's upper right wall, so it is placed on ell run 1 (the 8' S-going run); from 12" + length 72" = 84" fits inside the 96" run.

The window dashed box is drawn along the adjacent room's left (west) wall, lower half, so it is on adjacent run 3 (the N-going run starting at the bottom-left corner); from 24" measured from that bottom-left corner matches the drawn box.

Ell door: run 4 (bottom wall) is walked W from the bottom of the 5' jog; '@ 30"' taken as start-corner -> near jamb, which matches the drawn gap. Swing line is anchored at the jamb nearer that corner, so hinge = near.
Adjacent door: on run 0 walked E from the top-left corner; '@ 40"' -> near jamb, matching the drawn gap. Swing line anchored at the left jamb (the start-corner side), so hinge = near.
Adjacent room top and bottom walls are each labeled 10'; sides each labeled 13' - plain rectangle.
